title: fix(create-plugin): type the scaffolded vite.config.ts's test block
body:
Fixes #8139

## What was wrong

`buildViteConfig()` in `packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts` emitted a `vite.config.ts` that passes a `test:` block to a `defineConfig` imported from `vite`. `vite`'s `UserConfig` declares no `test` key, so the emitted file is **TS2769** — `Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'test' does not exist in type 'UserConfigExport'` — measured on this exact template by the emitted-code census (objectui#7864 / PR #8138).

Triage's severity reading, re-verified on `b38014e82`: `buildPackageJson` scaffolds `build` / `test` / `lint` and no type-check script, and `vite build` loads the config through esbuild, which does not type-check. So nothing in the scaffolded repo RUNS that check and the symptom is an editor-only red squiggle — p3, not p2. It is still red on day one in every plugin this generator writes.

## The fix

One emitted line: the config now opens with a triple-slash `reference types="vitest/config"` directive above the imports. That pulls in `vitest/dist/config.d.ts:33`, whose `declare module "vite" { interface UserConfig { test?: ... } }` augmentation supplies the missing declaration. It is a type-only comment: zero run-time effect, and `vite build` never sees it.

The `test:` block itself is untouched. PR #8042's ruling on #7524 keeps it deliberately for the out-of-repo audience, and the template's own docblock argues it is the only thing giving the scaffolded example test a DOM.

## Why the reference and not `import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'`

The card deliberately did not choose. Both shapes type-check identically **in the scaffolded repo** — measured: `vitest ^4.1.10` is a declared devDependency of the emitted `package.json` (`DEV_DEPENDENCIES`, templates.ts:87-96), so the import would be legitimate there.

They are not equivalent **here**. `vitest` is declared by this repository's root manifest and mapped by no package the census covers, so an emitted `import ... from 'vitest/config'` trips the census's root bound (`resolvesOnlyThroughRootManifest`) and the whole template is REFUSED instead of judged. Measured both ways on `b38014e82`:

| shape | census summary | diagnostics on `buildViteConfig` |
|---|---|---|
| baseline (`from 'vite'`, no reference) | `Judged 12 ... 7 refused by the root bound` | TS2769 + the `vite-plugin-dts` TS2307 — the census reports **`2 remain`** |
| **this PR** (reference, keep `from 'vite'`) | `Judged 12 ... 7 refused by the root bound` | TS2769 **gone**; only the `vite-plugin-dts` TS2307 — **`1 remain`** |
| the other shape (`from 'vitest/config'`) | `Judged 11 ... 8 refused by the root bound` | **`0 remain`** — but only because the block is no longer compiled at all, taking the TS2307 with it |

A clean number bought by not looking is the one outcome that census exists to avoid, so the reference wins. The reasoning is written into `buildViteConfig`'s docblock and into the pin, so the next reader who is tempted to "simplify" it hits the measurement first.

## The TS2307 on `vite-plugin-dts` is untouched, on purpose

It is an artefact of the instrument, not a defect: the scaffolded `package.json` declares `vite-plugin-dts ^5.0.3` (templates.ts:93) and the census resolves against this monorepo's root manifest, where it is undeclared. The card recorded it precisely so nobody cards it. `buildTsconfig()`'s `extends` path is likewise untouched — triage's unverified passing note, explicitly no card and no change.

## The pin, and its trade

`packages/create-plugin/src/__tests__/templates.test.ts` gains a `typesTheTestBlock()` predicate plus two tests: the pin, and its own reverse verification (strip the reference line and the predicate must say NO, rather than passing vacuously over a config with no `test:` block — the idiom the rest of that file already uses for objectui#3759).

**Trade, stated rather than assumed.** The census is report-only by objectui#7864's ruling, so without a pin nothing mechanical stops this regressing; the pin is the only guard. The cost is that it is a string pin over generated text, and it deliberately rejects the `vitest/config` shape too — a future maintainer who wants that shape has to delete an assertion whose comment carries the measured numbers. That is the intent: the choice was decided by a measurement, so changing it should cost a reading of that measurement, not a silent edit.

## Verification

Every command run in a dedicated worktree on `0e49b95d8`, heavy runs serialised through the shared verify lock.

```
$ pnpm exec vitest run packages/create-plugin/
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  21 passed (21)          # 19 before, +2 new

$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/create-plugin run type-check
> tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
(clean, exit 0 — the second invocation is what covers the test file)

$ node scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs --emit-census       # exit 0, report-only
  Judged        12 of 20 recognised template(s) reached the semantic phase; 1 failed to parse, 7 were refused by the root bound.
  Of which      ... 1 remain, and those are the only ones that say anything about the emitted code.
  [semantic]  packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts:270:17  TS2307: Cannot find module 'vite-plugin-dts' ...
  (no TS2769 anywhere)

$ node scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs                     # the BLOCKING gate, exit 0
Root bound:     no block imports a specifier that resolves only through this repository's ROOT manifest.
Semantic phase: 632 of 632 block(s) judged, 0 failed.

$ node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs                    # exit 0
✅  2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s).

$ node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs                         # exit 0
✅  check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 6650 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).

$ pnpm run check:unreferenced-sources check:comment-mask-corpus check:doc-fences check:phantom-deps check:self-import
(each exit 0; comment-mask reports its pre-existing declared residue of 1 file, unchanged)
```

**Reverse verification (ablation).** Run from the committed state, with a restore trap and on-disk proof, not from an exit code: the reference line was stripped from `templates.ts` (`git hash-object` before `1cef5f078`, after `aaa5efa66` — the mutation is proven to have landed), and both legs turned as predicted:

```
 FAIL  packages/create-plugin/src/__tests__/templates.test.ts > generated vite.config.ts
       > types the `test:` block it carries, so the emitted config is not red on day one
 Tests  1 failed | 20 passed (21)

  Of which  ... 2 remain ...
  [semantic]  packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts:296:3  TS2769: No overload matches this call. ...
```

Restore verified by byte identity rather than by exit code: `git hash-object` back to `1cef5f078`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.

**Lint, declared narrowing.** `eslint` was run on the two changed files only, not repo-wide. The narrowing is a measurement, not a skip: the population is **4453 files** per eslint's own config (`eslint . --no-inline-config --format json`, counted from the JSON), this run covered **2** of them with 0 errors and 0 warnings (`--format json` counts), and `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), so nothing in this diff can move the verdict on any file it does not touch. The full farm is CI's run.

## Changeset

`.changeset/khaki-cameras-attack.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/create-plugin` — the published package emits a different file than before, so this is a real behaviour change of the tarball, not an internal edit.
